name: n4_list_batches
description: List the write batches in this server's journal, newest first: batch_id, tool, station_name, ts, state (completed / in-doubt), verdict, rollback_of and rolled_back_by. Use it to find the batch_id for n4_rollback. A journal line that cannot be read is listed in unreadable and the reply says the list is incomplete. Reads the journal only; works without a session.
